summary_en: Kaga Electronics tender offer for Shinko Shoji common shares at ¥1,580 per share. Minimum purchase 19,226,700 shares; maximum purchase unlimited. Tender period extended from 2026-07-14 to 2026-07-29 (52 business days total, vs. statutory minimum 20 business days). Objective: complete subsidiary acquisition. Price unchanged; no competing bids anticipated per disclosing board.
title_en: Notification of Partial Amendment to 'Notice Regarding Statement of Opinion on Public Tender Offer for Shinko Shoji Shares by Kaga Electronics Co., Ltd.'
translation_en_brief: Shinko Shoji disclosed an amendment to its statement of opinion on Kaga Electronics' public tender offer for all outstanding common shares. The tender offer was initiated on 2026-05-18 at ¥1,580 per share with a minimum purchase threshold of 19,226,700 shares and no stated maximum. The tender period has been extended twice: first on 2026-06-26 from the original close of 2026-07-14 to 2026-07-29, extending the total offer window from 42 business days to 52 business days. This extension was made to provide shareholders with additional opportunity to evaluate the tender offer, considering response rates and future subscription prospects. The offeror (Kaga Electronics) stated the price of ¥1,580 reflects fair value and remains unchanged; no competing offer is anticipated. The stated objective is complete subsidiary acquisition. The 52-business-day tender period substantially exceeds the statutory minimum of 20 business days, intended to ensure fair process and allow for potential counter-offers.
